observations: Blue portable welding machine with a top handle.
Brand 'TIKOSUM' and model 'MOD: ZW-160' are printed on the side of the unit in photo 0.
Two black battery packs are inserted into the base of the machine.
A separate black battery charger with a UK-style plug is visible.
The unit is sitting on a cardboard box labeled 'TIKOSUM Lithium Rechargeable DC Welding Machine'.
No welding cables (electrode holder or ground clamp) are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Tikosum Lithium Rechargeable DC Welding Machine
claims.evidence: Text on the machine and box in photo 0.
Model ZW-160 is clearly printed on the machine in photo 0.
The machine is shown with battery slots and rechargeable batteries in photo 0.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or strike an arc.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine powered on and successfully welding a joint.

risks.risk: The lithium batteries may be depleted or have very low capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the battery indicator levels after a period of continuous welding.

risks.risk: Essential welding cables (stinger and earth clamp) may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the machine alongside its cables and connectors.

proof_requests: A video of the machine being used to weld a piece of metal to prove functionality.
A photo of the welding cables and any other included accessories.
A photo of the battery labels to confirm voltage and Ah capacity.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photos, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case condition (non-functional and missing cables).
